edges.reason: transfer forwards the call to the private _transfer implementation.
transferFrom forwards the call to the private _transfer implementation.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth (external swap) before the token balance state updates.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out via address.transfer.
_transfer performs the actual balance movement through _transferStandard.
_transfer reads the external Odin contract amount before applying transfer limits.
_transferStandard accounts the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard requests the current reflection rate.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call that can re-enter the transfer path via token callbacks.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH with transfer, which may execute recipient fallback and re-enter.
ETH sent during _transfer execution can re-enter _transfer before _rOwned balances are updated.
startTrading performs an external payable router call that can invoke callbacks.
startTrading performs an external approve call on the pair contract.
manualSwap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualSend forwards the ETH balance through sendETHToFee.
msg.sender becomes the from address of transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender and allowance owner in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the owner of the approve call.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the sender via _msgSender.
lowerTax is guarded by onlyTaxCollector comparing _taxWallet with msg.sender.
startTrading is guarded by onlyTaxCollector comparing _taxWallet with msg.sender.
endTrading is guarded by onlyTaxCollector comparing _taxWallet with msg.sender.
manualSwap is guarded by onlyTaxCollector comparing _taxWallet with msg.sender.
manualSend is guarded by onlyTaxCollector comparing _taxWallet with msg.sender.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in startTrading.
_taxWallet is the recipient of the ETH pushed by sendETHToFee.
_taxWallet is the destination of the low-level ETH transfer.
_taxFee is read while computing transfer values for _transfer.
_burnFee is consumed by the value computation used in _transferStandard.
_maxTxAmount bounds the amount accepted by _transfer.
_pair is compared against from/to inside _transfer.
_swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch of _transfer.
_inSwap guards against nested swaps inside _transfer.
_uniswap router instance is used for the swap call.
_allowances is read and reduced in transferFrom.
_rTotal is read and decremented by _reflectFee.
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply, which can be zero or manipulated.
_rTotal feeds the rSupply operand of the reflection rate division.
The external Odin amount call is made inside _transfer before balances change, allowing re-entry.

normalization_plan.reason: Input address parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
Recipient parameter is only used by the _transfer function logic.
Amount parameter belongs exclusively to _transfer value handling.
Tax rate parameter is consumed only when writing _taxFee in lowerTax.
Token amount parameter is used only by the swap routine.
ETH amount parameter is used only by the fee-sending routine.
Temporary balance variable exists only inside the _transfer swap branch.
Swap path array is a local construction of the swap function.
Temporary ETH balance check lives only within _transfer.
